capabilities: assign semantic importance levels (L1-L4) to canvas nodes and groups
replace node content with compact central titles when zooming out
fix the display to Detail, Structure, Overview, or Map mode independent of zoom
override node titles with shortLabel values and target line counts
pause semantic visibility to restore native Canvas rendering
disambiguation: Not a standalone mind-mapping or diagramming tool; it only changes how the existing Obsidian Canvas renders as you zoom.
extras: Uses internal Canvas APIs and DOM structures that may change between Obsidian versions, and large canvases with thousands of nodes can pause briefly during rendering. A Chinese-language Phase 7 report covers historical metadata recovery. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Semantic zoom for the official Obsidian Canvas.
problem: Canvas shows full node content at every zoom level, so large canvases become unreadable when zoomed out.
summary: Semantic zoom layer for the official Obsidian Canvas that swaps node content for compact titles and overviews as you zoom out.
